name: Layer 3: build the campsite story page

messages.content: Create an original 256x144 campsite story page in no more than 20 tool calls. Use exactly this efficient workflow: get_pixel_art_guide, get_storybook, set a named night palette, add the 256px page, paint the navy sky and grassy clearing, then create and paint one reusable asset each for tent, campfire, Mira, fox, pine tree, and star cluster. For each asset, combine outline, fill, shade, and highlight primitives into its single paint_asset call; do not call get_asset_image because paint_asset already returns its PNG. Add the exact rasterized text 'Mira followed the little fox.' in the upper-left sky. Use one stamp_assets call to place the tent left, Mira near center, fire at center, fox looking back on the right, four trees, and several star clusters. Finish with get_page_image. Prioritize completion over extra refinement and do not make any other calls.
